info.name: 05-AdminEntryPoints
info.description: Do the dashboard admin refund levers work? Self-contained (creates its own fresh Stripe card ride; no DB/Redis access). Exercises list + pagination by orderId, reject (no Stripe attempt, no driver-wallet leg, no BAP Refund invoice, no Commission refund invoice), /initiate (auto-approve: born REFUNDED with refundsTries 1, SUCCESS attempt, -rf2 Refund invoice), modified-approve (the admin override component set drives the refund to rf2 while the request keeps the customer's rf1), terminal-state re-respond guards, and the customer refund list showing all three outcomes. Asserted through the dashboard refundRequest list/info, the rider refund + invoice lists, the driver invoices and the driver wallet ledgerHistory.

pm.test('rejected request stays REJECTED with no refund', function () { var r = by('05 admin-reject'); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('REJECTED'); pm.expect(r.refundsAmount == null).to.be.true; });

pm.test('admin-initiated request REFUNDED rf2 with ADMIN_INITIATED code', function () { var r = by('05 admin initiate'); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('REFUNDED'); pm.expect(r.code).to.eql('ADMIN_INITIATED'); pm.expect(Number(r.refundsAmount.amount)).to.be.closeTo(rf2, 0.011); });

pm.test('modified request REFUNDED rf2 while requested rf1', function () { var r = by('05 modified-approve'); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('REFUNDED'); pm.expect(Number(r.requestedAmount.amount)).to.be.closeTo(rf1, 0.011); pm.expect(Number(r.refundsAmount.amount)).to.be.closeTo(rf2, 0.011); });
